title: xfg Configuration
description: Configuration file for xfg CLI tool that syncs JSON, YAML, or text config files across multiple Git repositories

id.description: Unique identifier for this config. Used to namespace managed files in .xfg.json manifest, allowing multiple configs to manage the same repo without conflicts.

files.description: Map of target filenames to their configurations. Each file is synced to all repos by default.

groups.description: Named configuration groups that repos can reference via 'groups: [...]'. Groups create a merge chain: root → group1 → group2 → repo overrides. Each group can define files, prOptions, and settings.

conditionalGroups.description: Conditional groups that activate based on which groups a repo has. Each entry has a 'when' clause (allOf/anyOf/noneOf) and the same files/prOptions/settings as regular groups. Merges after explicit groups, before repo overrides.

repos.description: List of repository configurations. When using directory-based config, repos can be split across multiple files. Directory-based config recursively scans subdirectories.

prOptions.description: Global PR merge options. Can be overridden per-repo.

prTemplate.description: Custom PR body template. Can be inline markdown or a file reference (@path/to/template.md relative to config file). Supports ${xfg:...} templating variables: ${xfg:pr.fileChanges} (bulleted file list), ${xfg:pr.fileCount}, ${xfg:pr.title}, plus all repo variables (repo.name, repo.owner, repo.fullName, etc.).

githubHosts.description: List of GitHub Enterprise Server hostnames. URLs matching these hosts will be treated as GitHub repositories instead of falling back to GitLab detection. Example: ['github.mycompany.com', 'ghe.internal.net']

deleteOrphaned.description: Global default for orphan deletion. When true, files removed from the xfg config will be deleted from target repos (tracked via .xfg.json manifest). Can be overridden per-file or per-repo. Default: false

settings.description: Global repository settings including GitHub Rulesets. Can be overridden per-repo. Settings are merged: per-repo rulesets override root rulesets with same name.

fileConfig.description: Configuration for a single file to sync

oneOf.description: Object content for JSON/YAML output files (.json, .yaml, .yml)
String content for text files, or file reference (@path/to/file) to load content from an external file
Lines array for text file output with merge strategy support

content.description: File content. Object for JSON/YAML files, string or string[] for text files. Use @path/to/file to reference external template files (paths relative to config file). Supports ${VAR} env interpolation; use $${VAR} to output literal ${VAR}. Omit for empty file.

mergeStrategy.description: Array merge strategy for this file. 'replace' replaces arrays, 'append' adds overlay after base, 'prepend' adds overlay before base, 'merge' deep-merges items matched by identity key (type, actorId, actor_id). Default: replace

createOnly.description: If true, only create this file if it doesn't already exist in the target repo. Useful for files like .trivyignore or .prettierignore where you want to provide defaults but let repos customize. Default: false

oneOf.description: Single comment line
Multiple comment lines

header.description: Comment line(s) added at the top of YAML files ('# ' prefix) and .json5 files ('// ' prefix). Ignored for .json and text files.

schemaUrl.description: YAML only. URL for yaml-language-server schema directive. Adds '# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>' at the top of YAML files. For JSON files, use $schema property in content instead.

executable.description: Mark the file as executable via git update-index --add --chmod=+x. Shell scripts (.sh) are auto-executable unless explicitly set to false. Non-.sh files can be marked executable by setting to true.

template.description: Enable xfg templating for this file. When true, ${xfg:variable} placeholders are replaced with repo-specific values. Available variables: repo.name, repo.owner, repo.fullName, repo.url, repo.platform, repo.host, file.name, date, and any custom vars. Use $${xfg:...} to output literal ${xfg:...}. Default: false

vars.description: Custom template variables for this file. Accessible as ${xfg:varName} when template: true. Root, group, conditional-group and per-repo vars merge per key, and later layers win.

deleteOrphaned.description: Track this file for orphan deletion. When true, if this file is removed from the config, it will be deleted from target repos. Tracked via .xfg.json manifest. Overrides global deleteOrphaned setting. Default: false

oneOf.description: Single Git repository URL
Multiple Git repository URLs (each becomes a separate sync target)

git.description: Git repository URL(s). Supports GitHub (git@github.com:owner/repo.git, https://github.com/owner/repo.git) and Azure DevOps formats

files.description: Per-repo file overrides or exclusions. Keys must reference files defined in the root 'files' object. Set to false to exclude a file from this repo. Set inherit: false to skip all inherited files.

inherit.description: Set to false to skip all inherited root files. Default: true

oneOf.description: Set to false to exclude this file from this repo

groups.description: List of group names to apply to this repo. Groups are merged in order: root → group1 → group2 → repo overrides. Group names must reference groups defined in the root 'groups' object.

prOptions.description: Per-repo PR merge options. Overrides global prOptions.

settings.description: Per-repo settings including GitHub Rulesets. Merged with global settings: per-repo rulesets override root rulesets with same name.

upstream.description: Fork upstream repo if target doesn't exist. When the target repo is missing, xfg forks from this URL instead of creating an empty repo. Mutually exclusive with 'source'. Supports SSH (git@host:owner/repo.git) and HTTPS (https://host/owner/repo.git) formats.

source.description: Migrate from source repo if target doesn't exist. When the target repo is missing, xfg clones this repo with --mirror and pushes to the new target. Use for cross-platform migration (e.g., Azure DevOps to GitHub). Mutually exclusive with 'upstream'. Supports SSH and HTTPS formats.

then.errorMessage: A repo cannot have both 'upstream' and 'source' — they are mutually exclusive. Use 'upstream' for forking or 'source' for migration, not both.

inherit.description: Set to false to drop every inherited prOptions field (including ai), then apply this layer's own. Not valid at root level. Default: true

merge.description: Merge mode: 'manual' leaves PR open for review, 'auto' enables auto-merge when checks pass, 'force' bypasses requirements using admin privileges, 'direct' pushes directly to default branch without creating a PR. Default: auto

mergeStrategy.description: How to merge the PR: 'merge' creates a merge commit, 'squash' squashes all commits, 'rebase' rebases commits onto base. Default: squash

deleteBranch.description: Delete the source branch after merge completes. Default: true

bypassReason.description: Reason for bypassing policies (Azure DevOps only, used when merge=force). Default: Automated config sync via xfg

labels.description: Labels to apply to created PRs/MRs. Labels must exist on the target repository.

branch.description: Branch name for sync PRs. Per-repo overrides group, group overrides global. CLI --branch flag overrides all.

ai.description: AI-generated conventional commit messages and PR descriptions. true = Anthropic with defaults; false turns it off (e.g. per repo). Falls back to the default message on any AI error. Disabled by --no-ai.

aiOptions.description: AI provider settings for generated commit messages and PR descriptions

provider.description: 'anthropic' uses the Claude Messages API. 'openai' uses any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (OpenAI, Ollama, Azure OpenAI, LiteLLM). Default: anthropic

model.description: Model id. Default for anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5. Required for openai.

baseUrl.description: API base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. With openai, a baseUrl makes the API key optional.

baseUrlEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API base URL, for when the URL must not be written in config. Mutually exclusive with baseUrl. If the env var is unset, empty or not an http(s) URL, this provider is skipped with a warning. Cannot name a credential xfg uses elsewhere such as GH_TOKEN.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Default: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY

headersEnv.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with the AI request, as header name to env var name pairs. Values are never written in config. If an env var is unset or empty, this provider is skipped with a warning. Cannot name a credential xfg uses elsewhere such as GH_TOKEN, nor a header xfg sets itself.

prompt.description: Extra instructions appended to the built-in system prompt

maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters sent to the provider, shared fairly across files. Default: 20000

fallback.description: Provider to try when this one fails for any reason. If it fails too, the default message is used.

aiFallbackOptions.description: Fallback AI provider, tried when the primary fails for any reason (missing key or header env var, network error, timeout, non-2xx status, invalid reply). prompt and maxDiffChars default to the primary's. One level only.

provider.description: 'anthropic' uses the Claude Messages API. 'openai' uses any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (OpenAI, Ollama, Azure OpenAI, LiteLLM). Default: anthropic

model.description: Model id. Default for anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5. Required for openai.

baseUrl.description: API base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. With openai, a baseUrl makes the API key optional.

baseUrlEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API base URL, for when the URL must not be written in config. Mutually exclusive with baseUrl. If the env var is unset, empty or not an http(s) URL, this provider is skipped with a warning. Cannot name a credential xfg uses elsewhere such as GH_TOKEN.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Default: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY

headersEnv.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with the AI request, as header name to env var name pairs. Values are never written in config. If an env var is unset or empty, this provider is skipped with a warning. Cannot name a credential xfg uses elsewhere such as GH_TOKEN, nor a header xfg sets itself.

prompt.description: Extra instructions appended to the built-in system prompt

maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters sent to the provider, shared fairly across files. Default: 20000

repoFileOverride.description: Per-repo override for a specific file

oneOf.description: Object content overlay for JSON/YAML files. Use $arrayMerge + $values directives to control per-field array merging.
String content for text files, or file reference (@path/to/file) to load content from an external file
Lines array for text files (uses merge strategy: replace/append/prepend)

content.description: Content overlay merged onto the file's base content. Use @path/to/file to reference external template files. Must match the content type of the root file definition.

override.description: If true, use only this content and skip merging with base. Default: false

createOnly.description: Override the root-level createOnly setting for this specific repo

oneOf.description: Single comment line
Multiple comment lines

header.description: Override the root-level header for this specific repo. Applies to YAML and .json5 files, ignored for .json and text files.

schemaUrl.description: YAML only. Override the root-level schemaUrl for this specific repo. For JSON files, use $schema property in content instead.

executable.description: Override the root-level executable setting for this specific repo. Set to true to mark executable, or false to disable auto-executable behavior for .sh files.

template.description: Override the root-level template setting for this specific repo. Set to true to enable xfg templating, or false to disable it.

vars.description: Per-repo custom template variables. These merge per key with the root, group and conditional-group vars for this file and win over them. Accessible as ${xfg:varName} when template: true.

deleteOrphaned.description: Override the file-level or global deleteOrphaned setting for this specific repo. Set to true to enable orphan tracking, or false to disable it for this repo.

groupConfig.description: Configuration group that can define files, prOptions, and settings. Referenced by repos via 'groups: [groupName]'.

extends.description: Parent group name(s) to inherit files, settings, and PR options from. Accepts a single group name or an array of group names. Parents are merged before the child group.

oneOf.description: Single parent group name
Array of parent group names, merged left-to-right

files.description: Files defined or overridden by this group. Keys are filenames. Set to false to remove an inherited file. Set inherit: false to discard all accumulated files from prior layers.

inherit.description: Set to false to discard all files accumulated from root and earlier groups. Default: true

anyOf.description: Set to false to remove this file from the group's output

prOptions.description: PR merge options for repos using this group. Overrides root prOptions, can be overridden by repo prOptions.

settings.description: Settings for repos using this group. Supports inherit: false on rulesets/labels sub-sections. Merged between root and repo settings.

conditionalGroupConfig.description: Conditional group that activates based on which groups a repo has. Has a 'when' clause and the same files/prOptions/settings as regular groups.

when.description: Condition that determines when this group activates. At least one of allOf, anyOf, or noneOf is required.

allOf.description: All listed groups must be present in the repo's groups array

anyOf.description: At least one listed group must be present in the repo's groups array

noneOf.description: None of the listed groups may be present in the repo's groups array

files.description: Files defined or overridden by this conditional group. Same capabilities as regular group files.

inherit.description: Set to false to discard all files accumulated from root, groups, and earlier conditional groups. Default: true

anyOf.description: Set to false to remove this file

prOptions.description: PR merge options for repos matching this condition.

settings.description: Settings for repos matching this condition. Supports inherit: false on rulesets/labels sub-sections.

codeScanningSettings.description: GitHub code scanning default setup configuration

inherit.description: Set to false to drop every inherited code scanning setting, then apply this layer's own. Not valid at root level. Default: true

state.description: Enable or disable code scanning default setup

querySuite.description: Query suite to use: 'default' for standard queries, 'extended' for additional queries

languages.description: Languages to analyze. If omitted, GitHub auto-detects languages in the repository.

actionsSettings.description: GitHub Actions settings for the repository (Settings > Actions). Each field maps to one field of the Actions REST API.

inherit.description: Set to false to drop every inherited actions setting, then apply this layer's own. Not valid at root level. Default: true

enabled.description: Whether GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository. Maps to enabled of PUT actions/permissions. With false, allowedActions, shaPinningRequired and the selected-actions fields are not allowed in the same layer.

allowedActions.description: Which actions and reusable workflows may run. Maps to allowed_actions of PUT actions/permissions. The selected-actions fields apply only when this is selected.

shaPinningRequired.description: Require actions to be referenced by full commit SHA. Maps to sha_pinning_required of PUT actions/permissions.

githubOwnedAllowed.description: Allow actions created by GitHub when allowedActions is selected. Maps to github_owned_allowed of PUT actions/permissions/selected-actions.

verifiedAllowed.description: Allow actions from Marketplace verified creators when allowedActions is selected. Maps to verified_allowed of PUT actions/permissions/selected-actions.

patternsAllowed.description: Action patterns to allow when allowedActions is selected, such as docker/login-action@*. Maps to patterns_allowed of PUT actions/permissions/selected-actions. A pattern starting with ! blocks the action. Compared as a set, and a layer replaces inherited patterns whole.

defaultWorkflowPermissions.description: Default permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN in workflows. Maps to default_workflow_permissions of PUT actions/permissions/workflow.

canApprovePullRequestReviews.description: Let workflows create and approve pull requests. Maps to can_approve_pull_request_reviews of PUT actions/permissions/workflow, which covers creating pull requests as well as approving them.

forkPrApprovalPolicy.description: Which contributors need approval before workflows run on their fork pull requests. Maps to approval_policy of PUT actions/permissions/fork-pr-contributor-approval.

artifactAndLogRetentionDays.description: Days to keep workflow artifacts and logs. Maps to days of PUT actions/permissions/artifact-and-log-retention. The upper bound depends on visibility and plan, and GitHub enforces it.

cacheRetentionDays.description: Days to keep unused Actions caches. Maps to max_cache_retention_days of PUT actions/cache/retention-limit. Needs a paid plan or a payment method on file.

cacheSizeGb.description: Maximum Actions cache size in gigabytes. Maps to max_cache_size_gb of PUT actions/cache/storage-limit. Needs a paid plan or a payment method on file.

rootSettings.description: Global repository settings including GitHub Rulesets and repository features. inherit is not valid at root level.

rulesets.description: Map of ruleset names to configurations. Set a ruleset to false to disable it.

oneOf.description: Set to false to disable this ruleset

repo.description: GitHub repository settings (features, merge options, security).

labels.description: Map of label names to configurations. Set a label to false to disable it.

oneOf.description: Set to false to disable this label

codeScanning.description: GitHub code scanning default setup configuration.

variables.description: Map of GitHub Actions variable names to values. Set a variable to false to disable it. Use deleteOrphaned to remove variables not in config.

deleteOrphaned.description: Delete variables from repos that are not defined in this config. Independent from the settings-level deleteOrphaned flag. Default: false

oneOf.description: Set to false to disable this variable
Variable value

secrets.description: Map of GitHub Actions secret names to SecretConfig. Set a secret to false to disable it. Use deleteOrphaned to remove secrets not in config. Only synced by 'xfg secrets sync', never by 'xfg sync'.

deleteOrphaned.description: Delete secrets from repos that are not defined in this config. Independent from the settings-level deleteOrphaned flag. Default: false

oneOf.description: Set to false to disable this secret

collaborators.description: Direct collaborators for personal (user-owned) repos. Org repos are skipped with a warning.

users.description: GitHub usernames to add as direct collaborators. Personal (user-owned) repos only; org repos are skipped with a warning. Users get write access and must accept the invite.

deleteOrphaned.description: Remove every direct collaborator and pending invite not in users (the repo owner is kept). Default: false

environments.description: GitHub deployment environments keyed by name. Set an environment to false to disable it. Environments on GitHub that are not listed are kept unless deleteOrphaned is true. GitHub repos only; private repos need a paid plan.

deleteOrphaned.description: Delete environments on GitHub that are not in this map, with their secrets and protection rules. Default: false

oneOf.description: Set to false to disable this environment

deleteOrphaned.description: When true, every ruleset and label in the repo that is not in the config is deleted, including ones created outside xfg. Default: false

repoSettings.description: Repository settings including GitHub Rulesets and repository features

rulesets.description: Map of ruleset names to configurations. Set a ruleset to false to opt out. Set inherit: false to skip all inherited rulesets.

inherit.description: Set to false to skip all inherited root rulesets. Default: true

oneOf.description: Set to false to opt out of this inherited ruleset
Set to false to opt out of all inherited repository settings

repo.description: GitHub repository settings (features, merge options, security). Set to false at per-repo level to opt out of inherited settings.

labels.description: Map of label names to configurations. Set a label to false to opt out. Set inherit: false to skip all inherited labels.

variables.description: Map of GitHub Actions variable names to values. Set a variable to false to opt out. Set inherit: false to skip all inherited variables.

Variable value

hasIssues.description: Enable or disable GitHub Issues. Warning: Disabling may hide existing issues.

hasProjects.description: Enable or disable GitHub Projects. Warning: Disabling may hide existing projects.

hasWiki.description: Enable or disable the repository wiki. Warning: Disabling may hide existing wiki content.

isTemplate.description: Mark the repository as a template repository

allowForking.description: Allow forking of a private repository

visibility.description: Repository visibility. Warning: Changing visibility may expose or hide repository content.

archived.description: Archive the repository. Warning: Archived repositories are read-only.

allowMergeCommit.description: Allow merge commits for pull requests

deleteBranchOnMerge.description: Automatically delete head branches after pull requests are merged

allowUpdateBranch.description: Show 'Update branch' button in pull requests

squashMergeCommitTitle.description: Default title for squash merge commits

squashMergeCommitMessage.description: Default message for squash merge commits

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Enable or disable Dependabot vulnerability alerts

automatedSecurityFixes.description: Enable or disable Dependabot automated security fixes

secretScanningPushProtection.description: Enable or disable secret scanning push protection

privateVulnerabilityReporting.description: Enable or disable private vulnerability reporting

webCommitSignoffRequired.description: Require contributors to sign off on web-based commits

defaultBranch.description: The default branch for the repository

arrayMergeDirective.description: Merge directive for arrays. Instead of replacing the inherited array, append to it, prepend to it, replace it, or merge items into it.

$arrayMerge.description: How to combine with the inherited array: 'append' adds after, 'prepend' adds before, 'replace' replaces entirely, 'merge' deep-merges items matched by $matchBy, or by an auto-detected identity key (type, actorId, actor_id)

$values.description: Values to combine with the inherited array

$matchBy.description: Key to match items on with $arrayMerge 'merge'; every item in both arrays must have it, with unique values

target.description: Target type: 'branch' for branch rules, 'tag' for tag rules. Default: branch

enforcement.description: Enforcement level: 'active' enforces rules, 'disabled' turns off rules, 'evaluate' evaluates rules without blocking (dry run). Default: active

bypassMode.description: When the actor can bypass: 'always' for all operations, 'pull_request' for PR operations only, 'exempt' to skip rule evaluation entirely (no bypass audit entry is created)

rulesetConditions.description: Conditions for when the ruleset applies

exclude.description: Patterns to exclude from this ruleset

requireLastPushApproval.description: Require approval from someone other than the last pusher
